senses.en: a unit of weight, 112 pounds in the UK or 100 pounds in the US

example.en: The farmer sold a hundredweight of potatoes.
example.zh: 农夫卖了一英担土豆。

senses.en: an informal word for grandfather; the father of your father or mother

example.en: My grandad loves telling stories about his childhood.
example.zh: 我爷爷喜欢讲他童年的故事。

senses.en: a small hot-tasting pepper used in cooking

example.en: Add a chopped chilli to make the sauce spicier.
example.zh: 加一个切碎的辣椒，让酱汁更辣。

senses.en: a person who is new to and learning an activity

example.en: The class is suitable for complete beginners.
example.zh: 这门课非常适合完全的初学者。

senses.en: business organizations that sell goods or services

example.en: Many companies allow employees to work from home.
example.zh: 许多公司允许员工在家办公。

senses.en: the state of being with other people; companionship

example.en: I enjoyed her company during the long trip.
example.zh: 漫长的旅途中我很享受她的陪伴。

senses.en: to hang cloth loosely over something

example.en: She draped a shawl over her shoulders.
example.zh: 她把披肩松松地披在肩上。

senses.en: curtains or hanging cloth, especially for a window (usually drapes, US)

example.en: She opened the drapes to let in the light.
example.zh: 她拉开窗帘让光线进来。

senses.en: the way fabric hangs or falls

example.en: This silk has a lovely drape.
example.zh: 这种丝绸垂坠感很好。

senses.en: a book or website that lists words in alphabetical order with their meanings

example.en: I looked up the unfamiliar word in a dictionary.
example.zh: 我在词典里查了这个生词。

collocations: look up a word in a dictionary

senses.en: to represent something as a symbol

example.en: The dove symbolises peace in many cultures.
example.zh: 在许多文化中，鸽子象征和平。

senses.en: the selling of goods to consumers, usually in small quantities

example.en: She works in retail.
example.zh: 她从事零售业。

senses.en: to sell goods to consumers

example.en: The brand retails its clothes through small shops.
example.zh: 该品牌通过小型商店零售服装。

senses.en: at a retail price

example.en: The bikes are sold at retail, not wholesale.
example.zh: 这些自行车按零售价出售，而非批发价。

senses.en: a person you work with or a partner in an activity

example.en: She is a business associate of my father.
example.zh: 她是我父亲的商业伙伴。

senses.en: to connect someone or something with something else in your thoughts

example.en: People often associate this city with jazz.
example.zh: 人们常把这座城市与爵士乐联系起来。

senses.en: having a lower rank or partial membership

example.en: He is an associate member of the club.
example.zh: 他是该俱乐部的准会员。

senses.en: the state of being pregnant or of being a mother; motherhood

example.en: The book explores maternity and family life.
example.zh: 这本书探讨了母亲身份与家庭生活。

senses.en: the fact of being the mother of a particular child

example.en: The test confirmed the maternity of the child.
example.zh: 检测确认了谁是这个孩子的母亲。

senses.en: for or relating to pregnant women or new mothers

example.en: She bought some maternity clothes for the last few months of pregnancy.
example.zh: 她为孕期最后几个月买了一些孕妇装。

senses.en: a place in a school, factory, or camp where people buy and eat food

example.en: We had lunch together in the school canteen.
example.zh: 我们一起在学校食堂吃了午饭。

senses.en: a small water flask carried by soldiers or travelers

example.en: He filled his canteen at the stream before continuing the hike.
example.zh: 他在溪边灌满水壶，然后继续徒步。

senses.en: attractive in a pretty or endearing way

example.en: That puppy is so cute.
example.zh: 那只小狗真可爱。

senses.en: clever or cunning, sometimes in an annoying way

example.en: Don't get cute with me—just answer the question.
example.zh: 别跟我耍小聪明，直接回答问题。

senses.en: unable to use part of the body properly because of injury, illness, or a physical or mental condition

example.en: The building has ramps for disabled visitors.
example.zh: 这栋楼为残疾访客设有坡道。

senses.en: (of a device or feature) turned off or not working

example.en: The alarm system is currently disabled.
example.zh: 警报系统目前已被停用。

senses.en: the legal status of being a citizen of a country, with its rights and duties

example.en: She applied for Canadian citizenship after living there for ten years.
example.zh: 在加拿大生活十年后，她申请了加拿大公民身份。

senses.en: responsible behavior as a member of a community

example.en: The school teaches good citizenship through community service projects.
example.zh: 这所学校通过社区服务项目来培养学生的公民素养。

senses.en: relating to geography or the features of an area of land

example.en: The two regions differ in geographic location and climate.
example.zh: 这两个地区在地理位置和气候上有所不同。

senses.en: a family name; also the Scottish philosopher Thomas Reid
senses.zh: 里德（姓氏；亦指苏格兰哲学家托马斯·里德）

example.en: Thomas Reid was a leading figure of the Scottish common sense school.
example.zh: 托马斯·里德是苏格兰常识学派的重要人物。

senses.en: the time between sunset and sunrise when it is dark

example.en: We watched the stars at night.
example.zh: 我们在夜里看星星。

senses.en: the evening spent on a particular activity or occasion

example.en: Friday is our family movie night.
example.zh: 周五是我们家的电影之夜。

senses.en: not anything; no thing

example.en: There is nothing in the box.
example.zh: 盒子里什么也没有。

senses.en: something of no importance or value

example.en: All their promises turned out to be nothing.
example.zh: 他们的所有承诺结果都是空话。

senses.en: not at all; in no degree

example.en: She looks nothing like her sister.
example.zh: 她一点也不像她姐姐。

senses.en: relating to the United Kingdom or its people

example.en: She is studying British history.
example.zh: 她正在研究英国历史。

senses.en: the people of Great Britain (used as 'the British')
senses.zh: 英国人（总称，与 the 连用）

example.en: The British are known for their love of tea.
example.zh: 英国人以喜爱喝茶而闻名。

senses.en: coming next after the fourth in position or order

example.en: She finished fifth in the race.
example.zh: 她在比赛中得了第五名。

senses.en: one of five equal parts of something

example.en: About a fifth of the students walk to school.
example.zh: 大约五分之一的学生步行上学。

senses.en: a unit of liquor equal to one fifth of a US gallon (US)
senses.zh: 五分之一加仑装的瓶装酒（美式用法）

example.en: He bought a fifth of whiskey at the store.
example.zh: 他在商店买了一瓶五分之一加仑装的威士忌。

senses.en: the feeling of annoyance when you cannot achieve what you want

example.en: She closed the laptop in frustration after the file was lost.
example.zh: 文件丢失后，她懊恼地合上了笔记本电脑。

senses.en: something that prevents you from achieving your goals

example.en: Constant delays became a major frustration for the team.
example.zh: 不断延误成了团队的一大挫折。

senses.en: insulting or showing a low opinion of someone

example.en: He made a derogatory remark about her work.
example.zh: 他对她的工作发表了贬损性评论。

senses.en: feeling or expressing great joy, especially after success
senses.zh: 欢欣鼓舞的；喜气洋洋的

example.en: The team was jubilant after winning the championship.
example.zh: 赢得冠军后，这支队伍欢欣鼓舞。

senses.en: an evil spirit or demon

example.en: In the story, a fiend haunts the old castle.
example.zh: 故事中，一个恶灵作祟于古堡。

senses.en: a cruel or wicked person

example.en: He was described as a fiend for his cruel treatment of the animals.
example.zh: 他因残忍对待动物被描述为恶人。

senses.en: (informal) someone very enthusiastic or skilled at something

example.en: She's a fiend at crossword puzzles.
example.zh: 她是填字游戏的高手。

senses.en: a person who has the legal right to vote

example.en: Each elector must register before the election.
example.zh: 每位选民必须在选举前登记。

senses.en: one of certain German princes entitled to take part in electing the Holy Roman Emperor

example.en: The prince was appointed a prince-elector in the fourteenth century.
example.zh: 这位亲王在十四世纪被任命为选帝侯。

senses.en: a member of the US Electoral College that formally elects the President and Vice President

example.en: Each elector casts separate votes for president and vice president.
example.zh: 每位选举人分别投票选举总统和副总统。

senses.en: the qualities regarded as typical of women

example.en: She expressed her femininity in her own unique way.
example.zh: 她以自己独特的方式展现女性气质。

senses.en: not willing to accept opinions or behavior different from one's own

example.en: He was intolerant of any criticism of his work.
example.zh: 他容不得任何对他作品的批评。

senses.en: unable to tolerate a food, drug, or substance without ill effects

example.en: Some people are intolerant of lactose.
example.zh: 有些人不耐受乳糖。

senses.en: a teacher or researcher at a university or college, especially one with a senior academic rank
senses.zh: 大学教师；教授（尤指较高级的学术职称）

example.en: She became a professor of chemistry at the university.
example.zh: 她成为那所大学的化学教授。

senses.en: a structure built over a river, road, or railway so people can cross

example.en: The old stone bridge crosses the river near our village.
example.zh: 那座古老的石桥横跨我们村庄附近的河流。

senses.en: to connect two places or groups, or reduce the difference between them

example.en: The new train line will bridge the two towns.
example.zh: 新的铁路线将连接这两个城镇。

senses.en: a card game for four players played in two pairs
senses.zh: 桥牌（四人两组进行的纸牌游戏）

example.en: They play bridge every Tuesday evening.
example.zh: 他们每周二晚上打桥牌。

senses.en: the raised part of a ship where the captain controls it

example.en: The captain stood on the bridge and watched the horizon.
example.zh: 船长站在舰桥上注视着地平线。

senses.en: able to make decisions quickly and confidently

example.en: She gave a decisive answer without hesitating.
example.zh: 她毫不犹豫地给出了果断的答复。

senses.en: having a major effect on the result of something

example.en: The team scored a decisive victory in the final game.
example.zh: 该队在决赛中取得了决定性的胜利。

senses.en: very tired, physically or mentally

example.en: After the long hike, he felt weary and went straight to bed.
example.zh: 长途远足之后，他感到十分疲惫，直接上床睡觉了。

senses.en: bored with or lacking patience for something

example.en: She grew weary of answering the same questions every day.
example.zh: 她渐渐厌倦了每天回答同样的问题。

senses.en: to make someone tired; to become tired or bored

example.en: The constant noise wearied the workers by midday.
example.zh: 持续不断的噪音到中午就让工人们疲惫不堪。

senses.en: causing pity or sadness; weak or unsuccessful in a way that makes you feel sorry

example.en: The abandoned dog looked pathetic in the rain.
example.zh: 那只被遗弃的狗在雨中看起来很可怜。

senses.en: extremely poor in quality; useless or inadequate (informal)

example.en: The team's performance was absolutely pathetic.
example.zh: 那个队的表现实在太差劲了。

senses.en: to bring something unpleasant upon oneself, such as a cost, loss, or blame
senses.zh: 招致；蒙受；承担（费用、损失、责难等）

example.en: The company incurred heavy losses last year.
example.zh: 这家公司去年蒙受了巨额亏损。

senses.en: a false idea or belief

example.en: He had no illusions about how difficult the project would be.
example.zh: 他对这个项目有多困难没有任何幻想。

senses.en: something you see or perceive that is not really there

example.en: The mirrors create an illusion of extra space.
example.zh: 镜子制造出空间更大的错觉。

senses.en: to encourage the development or growth of something

example.en: The teacher fostered a love of reading in her students.
example.zh: 这位老师在学生中培养了对阅读的热爱。

senses.en: to take care of a child as a temporary parent without legally adopting them

example.en: The family decided to foster two children last year.
example.zh: 这家人去年决定寄养两个孩子。

senses.en: relating to caring for a child as a parent would, without legal adoption

example.en: She grew up in a foster home.
example.zh: 她在寄养家庭中长大。

senses.en: to force someone to do something

example.en: The law compels companies to protect customer data.
example.zh: 法律要求公司保护客户数据。

senses.en: to make something necessary or unavoidable

example.en: Rising costs compelled the company to cut staff.
example.zh: 成本上升迫使公司裁员。

senses.en: to rub a surface roughly, removing something from it

example.en: She scraped the ice off the windshield.
example.zh: 她把挡风玻璃上的冰刮掉。

senses.en: a minor injury or mark caused by rubbing against something rough

example.en: He got a scrape on his knee.
example.zh: 他的膝盖擦伤了。

senses.en: a harsh scraping sound

example.en: I heard the scrape of chairs on the floor.
example.zh: 我听到椅子在地板上刮擦的声音。

senses.en: an informal word for a difficult situation

example.en: He often gets into scrapes at school.
example.zh: 他经常在学校惹麻烦。

senses.en: to become stronger or greater

example.en: The storm intensified overnight.
example.zh: 暴风雨在夜间加剧了。

senses.en: to make something stronger or more intense

example.en: They intensified their training before the competition.
example.zh: 他们在比赛前加强了训练。

senses.en: text displayed at the bottom of a screen, especially a translation of dialogue

example.en: The movie has English captions for foreign viewers.
example.zh: 这部电影为外国观众提供了英文字幕。

senses.en: a short title or explanation under a picture

example.en: Write a funny caption for this photo.
example.zh: 为这张照片写一个有趣的说明文字。

senses.en: to add a title or explanation to a picture
senses.zh: 为…加上说明文字或标题

example.en: She captioned the photo with the date and place.
example.zh: 她给照片加上了日期和地点的说明。

senses.en: to dig out earth or uncover remains by digging

example.en: Archaeologists excavated the ruins of an ancient city.
example.zh: 考古学家发掘了一座古城的遗迹。

senses.en: relating to magnetism produced by electric currents

example.en: Light is a form of electromagnetic radiation.
example.zh: 光是电磁辐射的一种形式。

senses.en: famous and respected, especially in a profession or field

example.en: She is an eminent scientist in the field of genetics.
example.zh: 她是遗传学领域一位杰出的科学家。

senses.en: intending to trick or mislead people; dishonest
senses.zh: 欺骗的，欺诈的，不诚实的

example.en: The deceitful advertisement promised results it could never deliver.
example.zh: 这则骗人的广告承诺了根本无法兑现的效果。

senses.en: (dated, often disapproving) a woman who has never married, especially an older woman
senses.zh: （旧用法，常含贬义）从未结婚的女子，尤指年长者

example.en: The old record lists her marital status as spinster.
example.zh: 旧档案把她的婚姻状况记为 spinster（未婚女子）。

senses.en: extremely bad or unpleasant

example.en: We traveled through abominable weather.
example.zh: 我们在极其恶劣的天气中赶路。

senses.en: very hateful and deserving disgust

example.en: His abominable behavior shocked everyone.
example.zh: 他令人憎恶的行为让所有人震惊。

senses.en: a jam made from citrus fruit such as oranges

example.en: I spread marmalade on my toast at breakfast.
example.zh: 我早餐时在吐司上涂了橘子酱。

senses.en: a North American grey-and-white songbird that can mimic the calls of other birds
senses.zh: 嘲鸫（善模仿其他鸟鸣的鸟）

example.en: A mockingbird sang from the fence post all morning.
example.zh: 一只嘲鸫整个上午都在篱笆桩上鸣唱。

senses.en: a violent, rough person who causes trouble

example.en: A gang of ruffians started a fight outside the tavern.
example.zh: 一伙恶棍在酒馆外挑起了斗殴。

senses.en: a car with a fixed rigid roof that otherwise resembles a convertible

example.en: He traded his convertible for a hardtop before winter.
example.zh: 入冬前他把敞篷车换成了硬顶车。

senses.en: to make someone feel uneasy or confused

example.en: Her calm reply disconcerted the impatient interviewer.
example.zh: 她平静的回答让不耐烦的面试官有些慌乱。

senses.en: the principles and methods of teaching

example.en: Good pedagogy helps students learn more effectively.
example.zh: 良好的教学法能帮助学生更有效地学习。

senses.en: needing or using great effort or energy

example.en: Hiking up the mountain is a strenuous activity.
example.zh: 爬上山是一项耗费体力的活动。

senses.en: strange and out of place; not fitting the surroundings

example.en: The bright sofa looked incongruous in the quiet old library.
example.zh: 那张鲜艳的沙发在安静的老图书馆里显得格格不入。

senses.en: to become smaller and covered with wrinkles because of dryness

example.en: The grapes shrivel and become raisins as they dry.
example.zh: 葡萄晒干后干瘪成葡萄干。

senses.en: to decrease in size, amount, or importance

example.en: The market for the product has shrivelled in recent years.
example.zh: 近年来该产品的市场已经萎缩。

senses.en: a tool or device used for a particular job, especially delicate or scientific work

example.en: The surgeon cleaned the instruments before the operation.
example.zh: 外科医生在手术前清洗了器械。

senses.en: a device used to produce musical sounds

example.en: She plays several instruments, including the piano and violin.
example.zh: 她会演奏好几种乐器，包括钢琴和小提琴。

senses.en: a legal document, such as a contract

example.en: Both parties signed the legal instruments.
example.zh: 双方签署了法律文件。

senses.en: sentences or phrases that ask for information or answers

example.en: The reporter asked the minister several difficult questions.
example.zh: 记者向部长提了几个难以回答的问题。

senses.en: matters or issues to be discussed or decided

example.en: Housing remains one of the key questions in the election.
example.zh: 住房仍是选举中的关键议题之一。

senses.en: doubt or uncertainty about something

example.en: There is still some question about the cause of the accident.
example.zh: 事故原因仍存在一些疑问。
